method: two-stage confidence association, world XY CV Kalman and offline RTS smoothing
speed_reference: estimated ground-relative horizontal speed, compensated with per-sweep IMU-stabilized KISS-ICP poses
gap_policy: reassociate up to 1.5 s; display interpolation only if bracketed observations <=1.2 s apart; terminal prediction <=0.35 s
direction_policy: motion direction only when speed >=0.7 m/s and sufficiently observed; never resolve front/rear from ambiguous box yaw alone
front_marker: 1 m beyond oriented-box support in the direction of motion
tail: last 1 second of ego-compensated rear-center trajectory, shown in current sensor coordinates
limitations: No ground-truth IDs/speeds: identity-switch rate and absolute speed accuracy are unverified.
Long occlusions may create a new ID. Fully undetected cars cannot be recovered.
Odometry drift and detection jitter affect speed. Stationary cars have no reliable motion direction.
